notes:
v4.6.52 — Fix: saving the IBKR bot table wiped your cloud login (bots fell back to local TWS)

🐛 FIXED — 'IB Gateway not reachable' even with cloud fully configured
• Saving the IBKR bot table (Tools → IBKR allocations) was overwriting the whole IBKR settings block and ERASING your Cloud-24/7 login (Run-on-Oracle toggle + paper username/password). With those gone, APEX thought cloud mode was off and tried your LOCAL TWS — showing 'IB Gateway not reachable' even though everything was set up.
• The bot-table save now MERGES your settings, so your cloud login is preserved. Cloud bots stay on the cloud.

If you saw this: after updating, your cloud login is kept across saves. Re-enter it once in Tools → IBKR → Cloud 24/7 if it was lost, then it sticks.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
